1.text: Nuko bene Data, ibisigaye turabinginga tubahugurira mu Mwami Yesu, kugira ngo nk'uko mwabwiwe natwe uko mukwiriye kugenda no kunezeza Imana, mube ari ko mugenda ndetse murusheho.

2.text: Muzi amategeko twahawe n'Umwami Yesu kubategeka ayo ari yo.

3.text: Icyo Imana ishaka ni iki: ni ukwezwa kwanyu no kwirinda gusambana,

4.text: ngo umuntu wese muri mwe amenye gutegeka umubiri we wezwe ufite icyubahiro,

5.text: mudatwarwa n'irari ryo kurigira nk'abapagani batazi Imana,

6.text: kandi ngo umuntu wese areke kurengēra cyangwa kuriganya mwene Se kuri ibyo, kuko Umwami wacu ahōra inzigo y'ibyo byose nk'uko twabanje kubabwira no kubahamiriza.

7.text: Imana ntiyaduhamagariye kwanduzwa, ahubwo yaduhamagariye kwezwa.

8.text: Ni cyo gituma uwirengagiza ibyo ataba ari umuntu yanze, ahubwo aba yanze Imana iha mwebwe Umwuka wayo wera.

9.text: Ariko rero ibyo gukunda bene Data, ntimugomba kubyandikirwa kuko ubwanyu mwigishijwe n'Imana gukundana,

10.text: ndetse musigaye mukundana na bene Data bose b'i Makedoniya hose. Ariko bene Data, turabahugurira kugira ngo murusheho kugira urukundo rusāze,

11.text: kandi mugire umwete wo gutuza mutari ba kazitereyemo, mukoreshe amaboko yanyu nk'uko twabategetse,

12.text: kugira ngo mugendane ingeso nziza ku bo hanze mudafite icyo mukennye.

13.text: Ariko bene Data, ntidushaka ko mutamenya iby'abasinziriye, mutababara nka ba bandi badafite ibyiringiro.

14.text: Ubwo twemeye yuko Yesu yapfuye akazuka, abe ari ko twizera yuko Imana izazanana na Yesu abasinziririye muri we.

15.text: Iki ni cyo tubabwira tukibwirijwe n'ijambo ry'Umwami wacu yuko twebwe abazaba bakiriho, basigaye kugeza ku kuza k'Umwami, tutazabanziriza na hato abasinziriye.

16.text: Kuko Umwami ubwe azaza amanutse ava mu ijuru aranguruye ijwi rirenga, hamwe n'ijwi rya marayika ukomeye n'impanda y'Imana, nuko abapfiriye muri Kristo ni bo bazabanza kuzuka,

17.text: maze natwe abazaba bakiriho basigaye duhereko tujyananwe na bo, tuzamuwe mu bicu gusanganirira Umwami mu kirere. Nuko rero tuzabana n'Umwami iteka ryose.

18.text: Nuko mumaranishe imibabaro kubwirana ayo magambo.
